text:
megan: Heads-up — billing flagged a set of requests being throttled by org-rate even though a project quota exists. Spike started after the auth-exchange proxy change.

devon: Can you paste a request id + headers so I can trace?

megan: req=ff12cc. Captured headers:
`Authorization: ApiKey org=org-22 project=proj-omega token=sk_live_...`
Proxy forwards: `X-Org: org-22` `X-Project-ID: proj-omega`
Post-exchange trace shows: `Auth-Exchange: true` and binder ended up with `impersonated_proj=proj-legacy`.

akira: Looks like auth-exchange is impersonating into a service account bound to a different project. If exchange happens after sampler/cache, final attribution can flip.

sam: Also noticed dashboards are inconsistent: some panels use label `project_id`, others `proj`. Aggregation mismatch undercounts project quota usage which hides the problem until billing shows up.

megan: UX pain: console only says "throttled by org" with no provenance. Support can't tell if it's token claim, header rewrite, or impersonation.

devon: Short-term fix: have auth-exchange preserve the original project claim in `X-Orig-Project` before any rewrites. Then update authz precedence to token_claim > X-Orig-Project > final headers. Minimal change and backward compatible.

infra-bot: deploy queued: auth-exchange-preserve -> infra-canary-4 (requester=devon) :rocket:

akira: Instrumentation: add metric `quota.attribution.change_reason` with values/tags `impersonation`, `sampler_prune`, `header_mismatch` so we can pivot failures.

sam: I'll add a grafana panel that breaks rate-limits by `quota.attribution.change_reason` and a conditional alert: fire if org_throttle rises >5% while project_throttle falls >3%.

megan: Tara — can the console show both `resolved_project` and `project_source`? Tooltip suggestion: "Resolved: proj-omega (source: token_claim). If impersonation occurred, X-Orig-Project will show original claim." That'll speed triage.

tara: Yep. I'll add the dual-line field and a link to the playbook checklist.

devon: Canary live on infra-canary-4. Early telemetry: `quota.attributed_to_project` recovered ~60% on the canary nodes. Leaving canary for 45m before wider rollout.

megan: Good. Please capture the exact telemetry queries and I'll write the postmortem blurb after canary completes.

sam: Metrics wired in grafana. I'll ping when the alert rule is active. :thumbsup:
